title: Prom and Semester
author: Quentin Nakamura
blurb: Ines Voss, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
